authorized_evidence.content:
Sales Stages

The standard sales stages are qualification, discovery, solution fit, technical validation, proposal, procurement, and close. Opportunities should not move to proposal until discovery notes and stakeholder mapping are complete.

Product Limitations

Northstar is not a replacement for a system of record, identity provider, ERP, or clinical decision system. Sales Representatives should not promise unsupported integrations, exact roadmap delivery dates, or customer-specific contract commitments.

Discovery Questions

Sales Representatives should ask about workflow volume, approval bottlenecks, reporting delays, data quality pain points, integration needs, and executive visibility. Good discovery connects operational friction to measurable business outcomes.

Handoff Rules

Sales must hand off qualified technical requirements to Solutions Engineering before technical validation. Customer-specific contract commitments must not be promised without approval from Legal and Deal Desk.

Approved Talk Track

Northstar helps operations leaders see where work slows down, which approvals are delayed, and which data quality issues affect business reporting. Sales Representatives should avoid promising product roadmap commitments.

Handoff Rules

When Sales receives a support issue, the Sales Representative should create or link the support case and include customer impact, account tier, urgency, and any promised follow-up. Sales should not run a parallel support process in private notes.

When Support identifies expansion, renewal risk, or contract dissatisfaction, Support should notify the account owner and Manager. The notification should distinguish product issue, adoption issue, billing issue, and contract issue.

Access Notice

This document is restricted to Sales Representatives and Managers. It contains internal sales enablement guidance and should not be exposed to general employees.

Access Notice

This document is restricted to Sales Representatives and Managers. It contains internal competitive positioning and approved objection handling.

Prohibited Claims

Sales Representatives must not claim that Northstar guarantees revenue improvement, replaces all existing systems, meets every regulatory requirement, or has committed roadmap features. Customer names and confidential deal details should not be shared.

Access Notice

This document is restricted to Sales Representatives and Managers. It contains internal product positioning guidance.
